name: logo-quote-popovers
title: Logo quote popovers
description: A logo wall where each customer opens a small panel with their quote, name and result, on click or tap and not on hover alone.
docs: Pass title, an optional description ('Select a logo to read what they said.') and customers ({ id, name, mark?, quote, person, role?, result?, href? }). Every mark is a button that opens a Popover anchored to it; the marks sit in the muted text colour with a small plus that turns into a cross, and the open one is full strength with aria-expanded. Only one panel is open at a time, Escape or the close button closes it and focus returns to the mark; when a panel opens, focus moves to the panel, which is named for the customer. Because it opens on press it works on touch and with a keyboard, which a hover card does not. The panel holds the quote, the person, their role and an optional result line that links to the story when href is set. Which panel is open is state you can own: pass openId (a customer id, or null) with onOpenChange(id | null) to control it, or defaultOpenId to start with one open, which is how a preview shows a quote; a panel that starts open, or that the page opens, does not take focus. labels carries the fixed words, with {name} filled in.
